age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

amount.description: Base quantity to buy or sell (the request's `amount`), a decimal string in units of `base`

avg_price.description: Average price of the filled part, a decimal string, quote per base: paid on a buy, received on a sell; null when nothing is filled or there is no best price

avg_price_after_fees.description: avg_price after the TransferRate of the asset the taker sends (x r/1e9 on a buy, / r/1e9 on a sell), a decimal string, quote per base; null when nothing is filled or the rate could not be loaded

base.description: Base asset queried, in the canonical form the route reads (echo)

base_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `base`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

best_price.description: Price of the best level of the walked side (best ask on a buy, best bid on a sell), a decimal string, quote per base; null when that side is empty or its best level's price is zero

book_truncated.description: True when liquidity is insufficient and the server returned as many offers for the walked side as the read requested, the depth bucket served, so the book may hold more than was read

depth.description: The requested depth, echoed; 100, the default, when the request names none

depth_effective.description: Depth bucket served: the requested depth rounded up to 10, 50 or 100, at most 100. The walk reads at most this many levels of the walked side

domain.description: PermissionedDomain id queried, upper-case hex (echo of `domain`); null when the request sent none (the open book)

filled.description: Base quantity the walk fills, at most `amount`, a decimal string in units of `base`

partial.description: True when filled is above 0 and below amount; the top-level prices then describe the filled part

quote.description: Quote asset queried, in the canonical form the route reads (echo)

quote_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `quote`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

side.description: buy walks the asks; sell walks the bids

slippage_pct.description: Percent; on a partial fill, of the filled part; null when nothing is filled or there is no best price

transfer_fee_applied.description: True when the transfer fee of the asset the taker sends is known (its issuer's TransferRate was loaded, or the taker sends XRP, which has none), so transfer_fee_pct and avg_price_after_fees are set; false when the rate could not be loaded, and both are null. best_price, worst_price, avg_price and slippage_pct never include the transfer fee

transfer_fee_issuer.description: Issuer whose TransferRate applies: the issuer of the asset the taker sends (quote on a buy, base on a sell); null when it sends XRP or the rate could not be loaded

transfer_fee_pct.description: Transfer fee of the asset the taker sends in percent, (TransferRate - 1000000000) / 10000000, exact; "0" when it sends XRP; null when the rate could not be loaded

venues.description: CLOB vs AMM comparison for the same amount; no routing split

avg_price.description: Quote per base: paid on a buy, received on a sell; null when it cannot fill

avg_price_after_fees.description: avg_price after the TransferRate of the asset the taker sends (x r/1e9 on a buy, / r/1e9 on a sell), quote per base; null when the rate is unknown

cost.description: Total quote for `amount`, in units of `quote`: paid on a buy, received on a sell; null when it cannot fill

slippage_pct.description: Percent vs the fee-free pool spot price (includes the trading fee), null when it cannot fill

spot_price.description: Pool spot price, quote per base, excluding fee and impact

spot_price_with_fee.description: Marginal pool price including the trading fee, quote per base: spot / (1 - fee) for a buy, spot x (1 - fee) for a sell, with fee = trading_fee_pct / 100

trading_fee_pct.description: Pool trading fee in percent (TradingFee / 1000, exact), like /v1/xrpl/amm

amm.description: Null when the pair has no pool, the pool is empty or frozen, or it could not be read (see amm_status)

amm_age_seconds.description: Age in seconds of the AMM read shown in venues.amm; null when venues.amm is null

amm_ledger_index.description: Ledger of the AMM read shown in venues.amm; null when venues.amm is null

amm_status.description: State of the AMM read: ok, stale (served past its fresh window), no_pool (no pool for the pair, or an empty one), frozen (a pool asset is frozen, so the pool is not used), unavailable

best.description: Venue with the better avg_price for the side (lower on a buy, higher on a sell; ties go to the CLOB), null when neither can fill

avg_price.description: Quote per base: paid on a buy, received on a sell; null when it cannot fill

avg_price_after_fees.description: avg_price after the TransferRate of the asset the taker sends (x r/1e9 on a buy, / r/1e9 on a sell), quote per base; null when the rate is unknown

cost.description: Total quote for `amount`, in units of `quote`: paid on a buy, received on a sell; null when it cannot fill

slippage_pct.description: Percent vs the best ask (buy) or best bid (sell), null when it cannot fill

worst_price.description: Price of the worst book level the reported fill reaches (the last level the walk consumes, in rippled's crossing order), quote per base; null when nothing is filled or there is no best price

description: Slippage and average price for buying or selling an amount of base currency. When to use: Before placing a market-style trade, to size it against available depth and to see whether the CLOB or the AMM pool gives the better average price for the side. Prefer another tool: It is an estimate, not a quote, and it does not split an amount across venues or route through other pairs. To read pool reserves, use the amm page. Example: xrpl_slippage {"base":"XRP","quote":"USD.rvYAfWj5gh67oV6fW32ZzP3Aw4Eubs59B","amount":"1000"} Paid: 0.02904 USDC or 0.0242 EURC per call on Solana mainnet, VAT included. With prepaid credits, debit per call: 0.02 EUR-denominated units (approx 50 calls per bundle) or 0.024 USD-denominated units (approx 34 calls per bundle).

amount.description: Positive decimal amount of base to buy or sell

base.description: Base currency: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.

depth.description: Levels per side: a positive integer no larger than 9007199254740991, rounded up to 10, 50 or 100; a larger depth is served at 100 (default 100)

domain.description: Optional PermissionedDomain id (64 hex): reads that domain's permissioned order book; slippage then skips the AMM

quote.description: Quote currency: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.

side.description: Trade direction: buy walks the asks (pays quote for amount of base), sell walks the bids (sells amount of base for quote)
